title: AskOut App
description: A fun and interactive web app that lets users create a personalized 'Will you go out with me?' page and receive the recipient's Yes or No response through WhatsApp.
highlights: Built a personalized proposal page using URL parameters to display the recipient's name.
Integrated WhatsApp sharing so recipients can instantly send their Yes or No response.
Added an international country code selector for phone numbers to support users worldwide.
Designed a fully responsive interface with Tailwind CSS for a smooth experience on mobile and desktop.

title: NEPA Log
description: Electricity tracking web app that lets users manually log when power comes ON or OFF and view their power history.
highlights: Built an interactive interface for manually tracking electricity availability.
Implemented LocalStorage to persist power logs across browser sessions.
Added real-time ON and OFF status tracking with timestamped logs.
Created power usage statistics and visualized electricity history with Recharts.
Designed a responsive dark-themed interface using Tailwind CSS.

title: Meridian STEM Academy — School Landing Page
description: School landing page concept featuring a live class-schedule strip that shows what period is happening in real time.
highlights: Designed a signature live schedule strip that reads the visitor's clock and highlights the current class period.
Built a fully responsive layout including a slide-down mobile navigation menu.
Structured content into a separate JSON data file for easy editing without touching component code.
Used scroll-triggered reveal animations with reduced-motion support for accessibility.
